text:
barb: Quick design huddle: deciding on a default validation pattern for the Console forms (project settings, API keys, secrets). Main questions: inline placement + wording, required-mark display, and delete-confirm UX. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/console-forms

noah: My vote: inline message below the field, left-aligned, with small error icon. Keeps scanning fast. Use a short top summary only when there are >1 errors after submit.

ivy: Agreed. For required fields I prefer the asterisk + an optional legend that says "* required" at the top of long forms. But for critical fields show a persistent "Required" badge.

chris: Don't overuse visible "Required" labels; it adds noise. Alternate: asterisk visually, and add `aria-label="required"` via sr-only for screen readers. Make sure asterisk contrast meets AA.

sam: Deletion: ops team recommended typed-confirm globally. That could frustrate power users who delete test projects often. Maybe a tiered approach: typed-confirm for resources tagged "prod" or teams that opt-in in settings. Otherwise show a checkbox + explicit warning.

barb: What about a soft guard like a 3s countdown + undo for less-sensitive deletes? Less friction than typing and still prevents misclicks. Could be default for non-prod.

ivy: If we use countdown, ensure it's keyboard accessible (e.g., button becomes enabled after countdown, and there's a focusable skip link). Respect prefers-reduced-motion to skip animations.

a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: 1) Inline error regions must be linked to inputs via aria-describedby; 2) For blocking summary use role="alert" with aria-live="assertive"; 3) Error links must move focus to the invalid input and announce it; 4) Typed-confirm input should have autocomplete="off" and aria-labelledby pointing to the prompt; 5) Provide clear accessible names for required markers.

noah: Microcopy: avoid vague text. Prefer pattern: "<FieldLabel> â€” <actionable instruction>" e.g., "API key name â€” enter a unique short name". For server errors include actionable next steps.

chris: Small UI detail: when an input has both helper text and error, swap helper text out and show error message in same spot to avoid layout shift. Or reserve the space for both states to prevent jumping.

sam: Telemetry: record delete_confirm_type (typed|checkbox|countdown), delete_context (prod|non-prod), and form_validation_mode (inline|summary|hybrid). We'll analyze accidental-deletes signal.

ivy: Edge case: long labels or multi-line fields. Error message should still include field label but truncate after ~80 chars and provide full label in aria-describedby.

barb: Action items: barb -> update Figma with 3 variants: (1) asterisk+sr-only required, (2) visible "Required" badge for complex inputs, (3) top-summary compact list with anchor links. noah -> draft microcopy examples for 10 common fields. chris -> create a small CSS pattern to reserve space for helper/error and show reduced-motion-safe animation. sam -> telemetry events and rollout gating. a11y-bot (followup) -> provide a short checklist for implementers.

noah: Also propose a small guideline doc: when to use typed-confirm vs checkbox vs countdown. I'll draft and share.

barb: Cool. Let's sync again once mocks are in. Thanks! :slightly_smiling_face:
